prompts.task: This is a narrow existing-exporter route recovery fixture, not a request to rebuild GenAI instrumentation or full five-mode reports. app.py already owns real generic trace, metric and log providers/exporters. route_recovery_source.py is a separate supplied application startup adapter. Use provisioned .venv/bin/python, no installs/sync, SDK package/global edits or cloud/model calls. Keep app.py, probe.py, original tests and eval/inputs immutable. Before repair run the actual immutable eval/inputs/capture_route_recovery.py --resolver LOADED_SKILL/scripts/resolve_ao_resources.py --output .observe/recovery-before.json. After repair run it with --adapter ./route_bootstrap.py --output .observe/recovery-after.json. The driver starts real numeric-loopback resource and native OTLP servers, returns201 on both creates, runs four separate app processes and an external identity rotation, and records raw journals and independent helper contrasts. Do not replace this with mocked helper return values or a copied expected ledger. Every process start must call the supplied real SDK-free resolver callback with the persisted selectors, validate fresh current binding and update only trace routing through the same public session. Retain harmless headers, endpoint and unrelated profile fields; atomically persist current resolved IDs only after success. Cached resolved IDs never bypass relookup. On lookup failure preserve the last good profile/configuration without applying stale selected routing; let the caller preserve the original app and ordinary native export paths with precise scoped failure. Execute and assert ordered201 creates, changed-ID clean-process relookup, repeated reuse zero creates, auth403 lookup failure/no speculative create/no stale header binding, identical original business outcomes and existing owner identities, and native metric/log requests with no routing headers. Do not add an AO SDK/client triplet, replace an exporter or add a second exporter to the same destination. Add only focused framing checks against the same actual SDK-free helper and startup resolution path using real numeric-loopback HTTP: Project-list and scoped Agent Stream lookup responses whose received bytes are valid JSON but shorter than their declared Content-Length must fail closed, issue zero POSTs, and never bind cached IDs. For each Project and Agent Stream create, a POST201 that commits the resource then truncates its declared response body must recover one exact same-name/parent identity by bounded relookup without repeating the POST. Record declared versus received body lengths, actual helper exit/result and request counts. Use synthetic private response-body markers and assert they do not leak through helper stdout/stderr, public error reports or emitted telemetry. Run the original business/native-signal path during these dependent routing failures and retain its outcomes, owners and unrelated exports. These are narrow HTTP framing regressions; do not repeat the full twelve-scenario resource matrix or rewrite application instrumentation. Also run actual startup/export with your adapter copied to a clean runtime directory containing declared app-owned assets and operator runtime configuration but no eval/.observe evidence dependencies; the external immutable driver may remain a test utility. Add/run the narrowest useful application-owned regression tests and save a concise .observe/route-recovery-instrument.md plus durable JSON commands/results/journals. This explicit adapter repair task needs no full new GenAI audit or fabricated canonical whole-app reports. Local fixture proof remains separate from actual Studio/cloud receipt. Use files/terminal/numeric-loopback only, no browser/UI. Also assess vendor-route-capture.json as a separate real captured source/SDK-field case: compare original versus candidate effective vendor project/stream/API/auth profile and the actual harmless generic OTLP header probe. Preserve original vendor destination and credential ownership when adding a distinct native destination, honor real generic-versus-trace-specific precedence, and never forward unrelated destination credentials. The resource adapter repair does not authorize edits to this separate vendor case. Record concrete source-bound verdict and required acceptance, not a generic preservation promise; captured field/function probes are not full lifecycle/cloud proof.
